shell_commands:
git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): split compound spec link into two statements

spec.md line 30 had two ([validated by ...]) groups on one statement,
which spec-links treats as the second link being outside the trailing
parenthetical, and re-lint/require-spec-link therefore cannot find a
spec link for the test at orchestratorHelpers.test.ts#L33.

Split into one statement per test: 'returns a when a reports and b is
absent' and 'returns b when b reports and a is absent'.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main 2>&1
